text:
anya_sales: Heads-up — Terra Corp wants to run a short POC next week focused on SSO + SCIM + RBAC. They specifically called out: IDP SAML metadata exchange, SCIM delta sync for 50k users, and domain ownership validation. Can SE + Sec confirm blockers?
sam_se: Ack. Need to know if they want hosted or dedicated. Hosted simplifies cert exchange and we can use our OIDC adaptor; Dedicated needs explicit SCIM throughput tuning.
liam_ps: From pricing side, if they hit 50k profiles we'll need to quote SCIM delta plan + dedicated capacity for steady sync windows. Do we have an expected sync frequency?
anya_sales: They said near-real-time (every 2–5m) for active employees, delta batched for others hourly. Also want RBAC: SCIM groups => role mapping and role-based route isolation.
miriam_sec: Important: Terra is in regulated finance. They'll require domain prove ownership via DNS TXT and SAML fingerprint pinned in their IdP. Also KMS integration note: they require customer-managed keys for audit logs.
sam_se: For SAML exchange we can do metadata + certificate rotate workflow. For the POC I'd propose: 1) Hosted short-term POC using our SAML endpoint, 2) Enable SCIM on a dedicated connector with throttling set to 100 req/s and delta windows to avoid spikes.
liam_ps: Pricing outline: Hosted POC (trial credits) => no charge for basic SAML testing. SCIM at 50k with 1m daily deltas likely pushes to "SCIM-plus" SKU. Dedicated capacity add-on estimated $X/month — I'll draft numbers once we confirm sync cadence.
anya_sales: Terra asked about automatic fallback if SCIM fails — they'd prefer queuing + retries vs user-facing errors. Is that supported?
sam_se: Yes — we support durable queueing with exponential backoff. For POC we'll enable retry policy and dead-lettering to an S3 bucket for audit. Config snippet I suggest we share: ```
scim: {
  mode: "delta",
  throttle_rps: 100,
  retry_policy: "exp_backoff",
  dead_letter: "s3://terrapoc-scim-dlq"
}
```
miriam_sec: Also confirm logs include user_id and request_id and are sent to their SIEM via syslog/HTTPS. They want retention 1 year and audit export. That affects pricing for observability retention.
liam_ps: Good catch — observability retention is add-on. I'll include retention tiers in the quote.
anya_sales: Any enterprise blockers we should raise now? Legal/security ask list: SOC2 + contract clause for domain proofing, SCIM rate SLA, data residency (they want EU region), and SLA for SSO uptime.
sam_se: EU region supported in Private or Dedicated; Hosted has multi-region but for strict residency we should propose Dedicated in EU. SSO uptime SLA exists on Dedicated.
miriam_sec: For legal: we need to confirm subprocessor list and provide a draft DPA. Also clarify KMS + HSM options for Private.
liam_ps: I'll add an appendix in the quote for Dedicated EU pricing + DPA/legal handoff.
anya_sales: Next actions: @sam_se to prepare POC runbook + config snippet, @miriam_sec to gather required security artifacts (SOC2, subprocessor, KMS options), @liam_ps to prepare preliminary quote with SCIM-plus + observability retention options. Terra wants a kickoff on Tuesday at 10am CET.
sam_se: I'll have the runbook and a minimal test plan by Monday EOD.
miriam_sec: I'll pull SOC2 and subprocessor docs and confirm KMS options by Monday.
liam_ps: Quote draft by Monday too.
deploy-bot: Reminder: created a POC workspace terra-poc-3180154321 with SAML test endpoint: https://poc.redwood.internal/saml/terra and provisioned demo SCIM connector.
anya_sales: Perfect — thanks everyone. Will schedule the kickoff and share calendar invite. :thumbsup:
